sections.text_helper: Section 30.5 "SDMMC functional description" in chapter 30 (Secure digital input/output MultiMediaCard interface (SDMMC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1375.
sections.section_content:
The SDMMC consists of four parts:
• The AHB slave interface accesses the SDMMC adapter registers, and generates
interrupt signals and IDMA control signals.
• The SDMMC adapter block provides all functions specific to the e•MMC/SD/SD I/O
card such as the clock generation unit, command and data transfer.
• The internal DMA (IDMA) block with its AHB master interface.
• A delay block (DLYB) taking care of the receive data sample clock alignment. The
delay block is NOT part of the SDMMC. A delay block is mandatory when supporting
SDR104 or HS200.
